findings: Explorer successfully maps staging textures with type WRITE and DONOTWAIT flag 1048576; the prior map-rejection loop is resolved. It proceeds through additional typed text and textured image draws.
Several real shell draws take 9-21 seconds. DWM creates devices but completes no draw; IDD never receives a swapchain or frame during the bounded observation.
The collector confirms the sole indirect topology from 15:55:56.885Z until 15:57:30.474Z. Input sends no keys because no frame arrives.

Two late Explorer failures occur during teardown: a draw fails and its capture is incomplete (1156 bytes), then resource creation reports device removed. All 33 worker requests succeeded. These errors do not establish a new unsupported shader.

DWM ETW decoding via tracerpt succeeds and preserves 40 event types, including device creation and occluded device-state checks. Get-WinEvent provider filtering found no matching records, so that failed query is not evidence that DWM emitted no events.
Both custom devices are removed and topology restored before a clean shutdown/restart of only the disposable VM. The fresh guest has the Basic Display Adapter and a normal signed-in desktop.
